purpose: Cross-language conformance vector for the canonical RI-RS hash-domain model.
conformance_requirements: Implementations MUST hash the exact bytes in input_hex.
Leaf digest MUST be SHA-256(0x00 || canonical_bytes).
Node digest MUST be SHA-256(0x01 || left_raw_32 || right_raw_32).
Hexadecimal child digests MUST NOT be hashed as text.
RI-PY and RI-RS MUST produce identical digest_hex values.
note: The node vector is independently computable and fixed by the DQ-002 ADR. The leaf digest is a placeholder pending independent recomputation and MUST NOT be treated as proven until verified by the conformance implementations.
